title: BrokerCredentialAuditRequest
description: P6-d (multi-tenant-broker-credentials): metadata-only hash-chain audit input for a tenant broker credential write or rotation. Carries ZERO key material — the api-key/secret never appears here (P6-c's BrokerCredentialSecretGuardTest scans this tree). Outcome is a CONTROLLED enum (no free-text reason) so there is no secret-leak avenue. The future UI-P2 caller maps the exec write outcome into this request and fires it on the dedicated per-tenant credential hash chain (strategy_id sentinel '_broker'). DARK in P6-d: the BrokerCredentialAuditActivities.record Activity is registered on the orchestrator-core worker but has no caller.

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose broker credential was written/rotated. Subject key and the audit event's tenant_id; the per-tenant credential chain is keyed on tenant_id + the '_broker' strategy sentinel.

provider.description: Broker provider the credential targets (e.g. 'alpaca'). A plain non-secret string, NOT the broker_target enum, to avoid the regen.sh BrokerTarget dedup collision.

change_type.description: Whether this credential write created the first credential for the tenant/provider row (CREATE) or rotated an existing one (ROTATE).

outcome.description: Controlled disposition of the write. A closed enum (no free-text reason) so the audit subject can never carry leaked key material. On any REJECTED_* outcome the optional broker_account_id/credential_version/kek_version are typically omitted.

actor.description: Who/what caused the credential write (e.g. an api-gateway route or operator id). Subject key and the audit event's actor.

occurred_at.description: When the credential write/rotation occurred (RFC 3339 / ISO-8601). Becomes the audit event's occurred_at.

broker_account_id.description: OPTIONAL. The NON-SECRET brokerage account number returned by the /v2/account identity probe (e.g. 'PA3FKGPFYPLH'). Omitted on rejected outcomes. NOT a key/secret.

credential_version.description: OPTIONAL. The persisted credential row version after the write (the CAS-bumped version). Omitted on rejected outcomes.

kek_version.description: OPTIONAL. The KEK version used to wrap the row DEK at write time. A non-secret version identifier, never the KEK bytes. Omitted on rejected outcomes.

correlation_id.description: OPTIONAL cross-event correlation key (e.g. the request id of the originating write).
